title: 慕尼黑奧林匹克體育場屋蓋~Munich Olympic Stadium roof
focus: 以 75 cm 等網目鞍形索網、邊索、桅桿與 3 × 3 m 壓克力板構成的 1972 年奧運帳篷屋蓋，及其形狀計算、張拉與保存~The 1972 Olympic tent roof of saddle-shaped cable nets with a uniform 75 cm mesh, edge cables, masts and 3 × 3 m acrylic panels: shape computation, tensioning and conservation
summary: 慕尼黑奧林匹克公園的帳篷屋蓋由多片鞍形索網組成，總面積約 74,800 m²，覆蓋體育場、體育館與游泳館，網目統一為 75 × 75 cm，上鋪約 8,300 片壓克力板。課程從負高斯曲率索網的預拉平衡與邊索、桅桿、重力錨塊的傳力出發，處理等網目索網與鑄鋼節點、壓克力板的熱脹與接合、地面編網吊升與預拉力導入，再談由實體模型走向迭代電腦計算的形狀確認、安裝量測、板材老化更換，以及列管古蹟屋蓋的重新計算與維護。~The tent roof of Munich's Olympic Park consists of several saddle-shaped cable nets totalling about 74,800 m² over the stadium, arena and swimming hall, all with a uniform 75 × 75 cm mesh and covered by about 8,300 acrylic panels. The course starts from prestress equilibrium of anticlastic nets and the load path through edge cables, masts and gravity anchor blocks, then covers the uniform-mesh net and cast-steel nodes, thermal movement and fixing of acrylic panels, ground assembly, lifting and introduction of pretension, and the move from physical models to iterative computer form finding, before turning to as-built survey, panel ageing and replacement, and recalculation and maintenance of a listed roof.

units.anchor: 鞍形索網曲面~Saddle-shaped net surfaces
units.title: 負高斯曲率鞍形索網的預拉平衡~Prestress equilibrium of anticlastic saddle nets
units.mechanism: 奧運屋蓋是由多片鞍形曲面組成的索網：一組索向下垂（懸掛索），另一組向上拱（穩定索），兩組在每個節點互相拉住，形成負高斯曲率。沒有外載時，兩組索的預拉力在節點上平衡；積雪等向下荷載由懸掛索增張、穩定索減張來承擔，風吸力則相反。只要兩組索都保持受拉，網就有雙向勁度；任何一組鬆弛，該方向的勁度消失，網會大幅變形甚至拍動。因此預拉力的大小必須讓兩組索在所有荷載組合下都不鬆弛。~The Olympic roof is a cable net of several saddle surfaces: one family of cables sags downward (hanging cables) and the other arches upward (stabilising cables), pulling against each other at every node to form negative Gaussian curvature. With no external load the prestress of the two families balances at each node; downward loads such as snow are carried by tension increasing in the hanging family and decreasing in the arching family, and wind suction does the opposite. As long as both families stay in tension the net is stiff in both directions; if either goes slack, stiffness in that direction disappears and the net deforms heavily or flutters. Prestress must therefore be large enough that neither family slackens in any load combination.
units.model: 節點平衡 p = t₁/R₁ − t₂/R₂（t 為單位寬度張力）。無外載時 t₁/R₁ = t₂/R₂；取 R₁ = 40 m、R₂ = 60 m、t₂ = 15 kN/m，則 t₁ = 10 kN/m。若 1.0 kPa 雪載由兩組各承一半，Δt₁ = +0.5×40 = +20 kN/m，Δt₂ = −0.5×60 = −30 kN/m，穩定索變為 15 − 30 = −15 kN/m，即鬆弛；網目 0.75 m 時每根索初拉約 11.3 kN。數值為教學假設。~Node equilibrium gives p = t₁/R₁ − t₂/R₂, with t as tension per unit width. With no load t₁/R₁ = t₂/R₂; taking R₁ = 40 m, R₂ = 60 m and t₂ = 15 kN/m gives t₁ = 10 kN/m. If a 1.0 kPa snow load is shared equally, Δt₁ = +0.5×40 = +20 kN/m and Δt₂ = −0.5×60 = −30 kN/m, so the arching family becomes 15 − 30 = −15 kN/m, which means slack; with a 0.75 m mesh each arching cable starts at about 11.3 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以非線性索網分析逐一檢查每個網區在雪載、風吸力、溫度與不對稱荷載下兩組索的最小張力，確認全部大於零並保有餘裕；同時檢查最大張力對索與節點的強度，以及網面最大變位是否會讓覆板之間的接縫失效。~Check with nonlinear cable-net analysis, zone by zone, the minimum tension in both cable families under snow, suction, temperature and asymmetric loads, confirming all stay above zero with margin; also check maximum tension against cable and node strength, and whether maximum net displacement would break the joints between cover panels.
units.failure: 預拉力不足的網區在大雪中穩定索鬆弛，網面下陷形成積雪窪地，荷載進一步集中而撕裂覆板接縫；在風中鬆弛的索會反覆拍動，節點夾具磨損鬆脫，最後連帶損壞覆板。~A zone with too little prestress lets its arching cables go slack in heavy snow, the surface dishes into a snow pocket, load concentrates further and panel joints tear; cables that go slack in wind flap repeatedly, wearing and loosening node clamps until panels are damaged too.
units.misconception: 索網只要索夠粗、夠強，就不需要預拉力。~A cable net needs no prestress as long as the cables are thick and strong enough.
units.practice: 設計文件要逐網區列出兩組索的預拉力、最小與最大張力及控制荷載組合，並把「所有組合下不鬆弛」寫成明確的驗收準則；任何改變網區形狀或荷載（例如加裝設備）的提案都要以此準則重新檢核。~Design documents should list, for each net zone, the prestress, minimum and maximum tension of both families and the governing combinations, stating no slack in any combination as an explicit acceptance criterion; any proposal that changes a zone's shape or loads, such as adding equipment, must be rechecked against it.

units.anchor: 440 m 邊索與錨塊~440 m edge cable and anchor blocks
units.title: 邊索、桅桿與重力錨塊的傳力~Load path through edge cables, masts and gravity anchors
units.mechanism: 索網的張力在網邊匯集到邊索，邊索沿曲線把力送到桅桿頂與地錨；sbp 的資料指出邊索為全封閉鋼索，拉索為平行鋼絞線束，接頭為鑄鋼。覆蓋體育場主看台的邊索長約 440 m，由重約 4,000 t、部分埋入地下達 30 m 的混凝土錨塊錨定；整個屋蓋共用 12 支大型桅桿，最高約 80 m。桅桿只受軸壓，靠拉索保持穩定，地錨則同時承受上拔與水平拉力，是整個帳篷結構最終的反力來源。~Net tension gathers at the net boundary into edge cables, which carry it along their curve to mast heads and ground anchors; sbp's data give locked-coil ropes for edge cables, parallel strand bundles for guy cables and cast steel for the joints. The edge cable over the stadium's main stand is about 440 m long and is anchored by concrete blocks weighing about 4,000 t, some extending up to 30 m into the ground; the whole roof uses 12 large masts, the tallest about 80 m. Masts carry only axial compression and stay stable through their guys, while ground anchors resist both uplift and horizontal pull, the ultimate reaction of the whole tent structure.
units.model: 邊索受網拉力 q、曲率半徑 R 時 T = q·R：q = 20 kN/m、R = 150 m，T = 3,000 kN。若錨塊合力 F = 20,000 kN、仰角 35°，豎向 V = 20,000×sin35° ≈ 11,470 kN、水平 H ≈ 16,380 kN；錨塊重 4,000 t 即 W ≈ 39,240 kN，抗上拔係數 W/V ≈ 3.4，但底面摩擦 μ = 0.5 只提供 (W − V)×0.5 ≈ 13,880 kN，小於 H，需靠埋深的被動土壓。除錨重外為教學假設。~An edge cable under net pull q with curvature radius R carries T = q·R: q = 20 kN/m and R = 150 m give T = 3,000 kN. If an anchor block takes F = 20,000 kN at 35° elevation, V = 20,000×sin35° ≈ 11,470 kN and H ≈ 16,380 kN; a 4,000 t block weighs W ≈ 39,240 kN, giving an uplift factor W/V ≈ 3.4, but base friction with μ = 0.5 supplies only (W − V)×0.5 ≈ 13,880 kN, less than H, so passive earth pressure from embedment is needed. All values except the block weight are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以非線性模型輸出每支桅桿的軸力、拉索力與每個錨塊的合力方向，檢查桅桿挫屈（含桅頂偏心）、拉索與鑄鋼接頭強度，以及錨塊的抗上拔、抗滑與地盤承載；施工時量測錨塊位移，確認被動土壓發揮前的變位在允許範圍內。~Extract from the nonlinear model each mast's axial force, guy forces and the resultant direction at every anchor block; check mast buckling including head eccentricity, guy and cast-node strength, and anchor uplift, sliding and bearing; during construction survey anchor-block movement to confirm displacement before passive resistance mobilises stays within limits.
units.failure: 錨塊只按重量抗上拔設計而忽略水平分力，受力後錨塊滑移，邊索與網面張力同時下降，網面下垂；桅桿拉索若有一根斷裂或錨具失效，桅桿失穩會牽動整片網，這也是索結構需要檢討單一構件失效後果的原因。~Designing an anchor for uplift by weight alone and ignoring the horizontal component lets the block slide under load, dropping tension in the edge cable and net together so the surface sags; if one mast guy breaks or its anchorage fails, mast instability drags the whole net, which is why cable structures need an assessment of single-member loss.
units.misconception: 錨塊夠重就能錨住索結構，水平拉力不重要。~A heavy enough anchor block secures a cable structure, so horizontal pull does not matter.
units.practice: 每個錨塊與桅桿基礎都要有獨立的承載、抗拔與抗滑計算，並在設計報告中做單一拉索或錨具失效的情境分析；錨塊周邊的開挖或回填變更須經結構工程師同意。~Each anchor block and mast foundation needs its own bearing, uplift and sliding calculation, and the design report should analyse the loss of a single guy or anchorage; any excavation or backfill change around an anchor block requires the structural engineer's agreement.

units.anchor: 75 cm 等網目與鑄鋼節點~75 cm uniform mesh and cast nodes
units.title: 等網目索網與節點夾具~Uniform-mesh nets and node clamps
units.mechanism: 奧運屋蓋的每片索網都採用 75 × 75 cm 的固定網目：索段長度一致，雙曲面的形狀靠網格角度改變（剪切）來達成，就像漁網拉成曲面時方格變成菱形。這讓索網可以在地面以標準長度編成，節點夾具也能標準化，只要節點允許兩索之間的夾角轉動。網目越小，覆板支點越多、局部荷載越小，但節點數目也隨之暴增，製造與安裝的工作量取決於節點數量。~Every net of the Olympic roof uses a fixed 75 × 75 cm mesh: cable segments between nodes are equal in length, and the doubly curved shape is reached by changing the angle between cables (shearing), like a fishing net whose squares become rhombuses when pulled over a curved surface. This lets nets be assembled on the ground in standard lengths with standardised node clamps, provided each node allows the angle between the two cables to rotate. A smaller mesh means more support points for cover panels and smaller local loads, but node numbers multiply, and fabrication and erection effort scales with the number of nodes.
units.model: 每平方公尺節點數 = 1/0.75² ≈ 1.78，74,800 m² 約有 74,800×1.78 ≈ 133,000 個節點，與營運單位公布的 137,000 個節點相當。邊長 a = 0.75 m 的網格由 90° 剪切到 60° 時，面積由 a² = 0.5625 m² 降為 a²·sin60° ≈ 0.487 m²，減少約 13%，曲面即由此形成。面積與節點數取自公開資料，剪切角為教學假設。~Nodes per square metre = 1/0.75² ≈ 1.78, so 74,800 m² holds about 74,800×1.78 ≈ 133,000 nodes, consistent with the 137,000 published by the operator. Shearing a mesh of side a = 0.75 m from 90° to 60° reduces its area from a² = 0.5625 m² to a²·sin60° ≈ 0.487 m², about 13% less, which is how the curved surface forms. Area and node count are published values; the shear angle is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 節點夾具做抗滑與轉角試驗，確認在設計張力下兩索可自由轉動而不沿索滑移；編網時以樣板檢查每段網目長度，抽查節點夾緊力；吊升後量測代表性網格的角度，與計算的剪切角比較，判斷網面形狀是否正確。~Test node clamps for slip and rotation, confirming the two cables can rotate freely under design tension without slipping along the cable; during net assembly check every mesh length with a template and spot-check node clamping force; after lifting measure the angles of representative meshes against computed shear angles to judge whether the surface shape is right.
units.failure: 節點夾具夾得太緊而無法轉動，網面在剪切成形時被迫產生額外索力與局部皺折；夾得太鬆則索在節點滑移，網目長度改變，局部預拉力喪失，覆板支點錯位。~Node clamps tightened so hard that they cannot rotate force extra cable tension and local kinks as the net shears into shape; clamps too loose let cables slip through nodes, changing mesh lengths, losing local prestress and misaligning panel supports.
units.misconception: 要做出雙曲面索網，每段索都必須裁成不同長度。~To make a doubly curved cable net, every cable segment must be cut to a different length.
units.practice: 等網目索網的製造規範要規定網目長度允差、節點夾緊力與允許轉角，並以足尺樣網試驗確認；節點編號系統應能對應到設計模型中的每個節點，以便日後檢測紀錄定位。~The fabrication specification for a uniform-mesh net should set mesh-length tolerance, node clamping force and permitted rotation, confirmed by a full-scale sample net; the node numbering system should map onto every node of the design model so later inspection records can be located.

units.anchor: 3 × 3 m 壓克力覆板~3 × 3 m acrylic panels
units.title: 壓克力覆板的熱脹、固定與接縫~Thermal movement, fixing and joints of acrylic panels
units.mechanism: 屋蓋以約 8,300 片、每片約 3 × 3 m 的藍灰色壓克力板覆蓋，板片以點狀柔性固定件安裝在索網節點上，板與板之間留有可伸縮的接縫。壓克力的熱膨脹係數約為鋼的六倍，夏季日曬時板片膨脹遠大於下方的鋼索網，若固定件不允許相對滑動，板會翹曲或在孔邊開裂。索網在風雪下也會變形，覆板必須跟著轉動而不把荷載傳到相鄰板，因此固定件與接縫的柔性與覆板強度同樣重要。~The roof is covered by about 8,300 blue-grey acrylic panels of about 3 × 3 m, point-fixed to net nodes by flexible fittings with movement joints between panels. Acrylic expands about six times as much as steel, so in summer sun the panels grow far more than the cable net beneath; fittings that do not allow relative sliding make panels bow or crack at their holes. The net also deforms under wind and snow, and the panels must rotate with it without passing load to their neighbours, so the flexibility of fittings and joints matters as much as panel strength.
units.model: 熱脹 ΔL = αLΔT。壓克力 α ≈ 70×10⁻⁶ /°C、板長 L = 3,000 mm、溫差 ΔT = 50°C：ΔL ≈ 10.5 mm；同長度鋼索網 α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C 只伸長約 1.8 mm，相對位移約 8.7 mm，接縫與固定件必須吸收。8,300 片 × 9 m² ≈ 74,700 m²，與公布面積相符。α 與溫差為教學假設。~Thermal movement ΔL = αLΔT. For acrylic with α ≈ 70×10⁻⁶ /°C, a 3,000 mm panel and ΔT = 50°C give ΔL ≈ 10.5 mm, while the steel net over the same length, α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C, grows only about 1.8 mm, leaving about 8.7 mm of relative movement for joints and fittings to absorb. 8,300 panels × 9 m² ≈ 74,700 m², consistent with the published area. α and the temperature range are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 覆板材料以抗彎、衝擊、耐候與防火試驗驗收；固定件做往復滑動試驗，確認在設計溫差的行程下不卡死、不磨損；安裝後於冬夏兩季檢查接縫寬度與板面翹曲，並以紅外線或目視檢查孔邊是否出現微裂。~Accept panel material by bending, impact, weathering and fire tests; cycle fittings through the design thermal stroke to confirm they neither jam nor wear; after installation inspect joint widths and panel bowing in winter and summer, and check hole edges for micro-cracks visually or by infrared.
units.failure: 固定孔周邊沒有留滑動間隙，夏季板片膨脹被鎖住，孔邊應力集中而放射狀開裂，雨水由裂縫滲入；接縫密封條老化變硬後失去伸縮能力，板片互相頂撞或接縫脫開漏水。~Fixing holes without sliding clearance lock in summer expansion, concentrating stress so radial cracks grow from hole edges and let rain through; joint seals that age and harden lose their movement capacity, so panels butt against each other or joints open and leak.
units.misconception: 透明覆板只是遮雨用，不需要考慮熱脹與索網變形。~Transparent cover panels only keep the rain out and need no allowance for thermal movement or net deformation.
units.practice: 覆板固定件設計要寫明滑動方向、行程、孔徑與墊片材料，接縫密封要指定材料壽命與更換方式；更換覆板時必須使用同等熱脹與強度特性的材料，並經結構與建築設計者共同核可。~Panel-fixing design should state sliding directions, travel, hole size and washer material, and joint seals should specify service life and replacement method; replacement panels must have equivalent thermal-expansion and strength properties and be approved jointly by the structural and architectural designers.

units.anchor: 地面編網與吊升~Ground net assembly and lifting
units.title: 地面預製索網與吊升就位~Ground-assembled nets lifted into place
units.mechanism: 索網在地面依標準網目編成，連同節點夾具與部分邊索一起準備，再由已豎立並以拉索穩定的桅桿把網吊升到位。吊升過程中網面幾何不斷改變，網只靠自重與吊點維持形狀，風會讓尚未張拉的網大幅擺動；桅桿在吊升時承受的不平衡水平力也與完成狀態不同。因此吊升順序、吊點分配與臨時拉索都必須以施工階段分析確認，並在吊升後才連接邊索與錨具、導入預拉力。~Nets were assembled on the ground to the standard mesh, prepared with node clamps and parts of the edge cables, then lifted into position by masts already raised and stabilised by their guys. During lifting the net geometry changes continuously and the net holds its shape only by self-weight and pick points, so wind swings an untensioned net widely, and the masts see unbalanced horizontal forces unlike their final state. The lifting sequence, distribution of pick points and temporary guys must therefore be confirmed by construction-stage analysis, with edge cables and anchorages connected and prestress introduced only after lifting.
units.model: 某網區面積 8,000 m²，索與節點自重取 8 kg/m²，重約 8×8,000 = 64 t。由 4 個吊點分擔、動力係數 1.2，每點約 64/4×1.2 ≈ 19.2 t，即約 188 kN。若因不同步使 2 個吊點承擔全部重量，每點升到約 38 t，桅桿頂水平分力隨之倍增。網區面積與單位重為教學假設。~A net zone of 8,000 m² with cables and nodes weighing 8 kg/m² weighs about 8×8,000 = 64 t. Shared by 4 pick points with a dynamic factor of 1.2, each carries about 64/4×1.2 ≈ 19.2 t, about 188 kN. If loss of synchronisation leaves 2 pick points carrying the whole weight, each rises to about 38 t and the horizontal component at the mast heads doubles. Zone area and unit weight are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 吊升前檢查桅桿拉索與臨時錨具的張力、絞車與吊具的額定與證書；吊升中監測每個吊點的拉力與高程，並量測桅桿頂位移；就位後先臨時固定，經測量確認網面與錨點位置，再進入預拉階段。~Before lifting check tensions in mast guys and temporary anchors and the ratings and certificates of winches and rigging; during lifting monitor each pick point's load and level and survey mast-head movement; once in position fix temporarily and survey the net and anchor points before moving on to prestressing.
units.failure: 吊升時桅桿拉索只按完成狀態的力設計，未考慮施工中的不平衡水平力，桅桿頂過度偏移甚至傾倒；在風中吊升未張拉的網，網面擺動纏繞拉索或撞擊已完成的結構。~Mast guys designed only for final-state forces, ignoring unbalanced horizontal forces during erection, can let mast heads drift excessively or even topple; lifting an untensioned net in wind lets it swing into guys or completed structure.
units.misconception: 桅桿完成後就很穩定，吊網時不需要額外的臨時拉索。~Once masts are erected they are stable, so no extra temporary guys are needed while lifting nets.
units.practice: 吊網計畫須包含每一階段的桅桿與臨時拉索受力、吊點拉力預測、風速上限與緊急固定措施，並由結構設計者與施工單位共同核可；吊升與固定的每一步都是停止點，量測合格才進行下一步。~A net-lifting plan must include mast and temporary-guy forces at every stage, predicted pick-point loads, a wind limit and emergency restraint measures, approved jointly by the structural designer and contractor; each lifting and fixing step is a hold point that proceeds only after the survey passes.

units.anchor: 拉索端預拉力導入~Pretension at guy anchorages
units.title: 由邊索與拉索導入預拉力~Introducing pretension through edge and guy cables
units.mechanism: 索網就位後，預拉力透過邊索與拉索的錨端導入：以液壓千斤頂拉長可調錨具，使整片網的索段長度在幾何上被拉緊。由於網的形狀由網目長度與邊界決定，拉伸任一錨端都會改變整片網的張力分布，因此張拉要依分析決定的順序分階段在多個錨點交替進行，避免一處先到位、另一處遠低於目標。千斤頂伸長量與力必須同時記錄：伸長包含拉索本身的彈性伸長與網面幾何變化兩部分。~Once the net is in place, pretension is introduced through anchorages of edge and guy cables: hydraulic jacks extend adjustable anchors so the cable segments of the whole net are drawn tight geometrically. Because net shape is fixed by mesh lengths and boundaries, stressing any one anchor changes the tension distribution of the whole net, so tensioning proceeds in analysed stages alternating among several anchors, avoiding one reaching target while another lags far below. Jack extension and force must both be recorded, the extension comprising the elastic stretch of the guy itself and the geometric change of the net.
units.model: 平行鋼絞線束拉索 A = 5,000 mm²、E = 195 GPa，EA = 975,000 kN；長 L = 120 m 時，張拉至 F = 5,000 kN 的彈性伸長 ΔL = FL/EA = 5,000×120/975,000 ≈ 0.62 m。若千斤頂實際行程 0.90 m，多出的約 0.28 m 來自網面幾何變化；若實測行程遠小於預測，可能表示錨端或網面受阻。數值為教學假設。~A parallel-strand guy with A = 5,000 mm² and E = 195 GPa has EA = 975,000 kN; over L = 120 m, stressing to F = 5,000 kN stretches it elastically by ΔL = FL/EA = 5,000×120/975,000 ≈ 0.62 m. If the actual jack stroke is 0.90 m, the extra 0.28 m comes from geometric change of the net; a stroke far below prediction may indicate a blocked anchorage or net. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每一階段同時記錄千斤頂壓力、行程、錨具位置與當時溫度，並與施工階段分析的力—行程預測比較，兩者偏差超過約 5% 時暫停檢討；全部完成後抽查各網區索力與網面標高，作為完工基準。~At every stage record jack pressure, stroke, anchor position and temperature together and compare with the force–stroke prediction of the construction-stage analysis, pausing for review when they differ by more than about 5%; after completion spot-check cable forces and surface levels in each zone as the as-built baseline.
units.failure: 只按千斤頂力控制而不看行程，可能在錨端摩擦或網面卡住時誤以為已達目標，實際網面預拉不足；單點一次張拉到位會讓相鄰網區暫時過載，節點夾具滑移，造成不可逆的網目變形。~Controlling by jack force alone without watching stroke can falsely signal success when anchorage friction or a snagged net holds back the force, leaving the surface under-tensioned; stressing one anchor fully in a single step temporarily overloads adjacent zones and slips node clamps, permanently distorting the mesh.
units.misconception: 張拉索網就是把每個錨端各自拉到設計力即可，順序不重要。~Tensioning a cable net simply means pulling each anchor to its design force; order does not matter.
units.practice: 張拉程序書要列出錨點順序、每階段目標力與行程、允許偏差與停止條件，並由結構設計者簽認；張拉屬高能量作業，現場須設警戒區並由合格人員依核准程序執行，本課只說明檢核邏輯。~The tensioning procedure should list anchor order, target force and stroke per stage, allowable deviation and stop conditions, signed by the structural designer; tensioning is high-energy work that requires an exclusion zone and qualified personnel under an approved procedure, and this course explains only the checking logic.

units.anchor: 實體模型與迭代計算~Physical models and iterative computation
units.title: 從 Frei Otto 實體模型到迭代電腦計算~From Frei Otto's physical models to iterative computation
units.mechanism: 競圖時的概念模型是 1:1000 的木棍與尼龍襪構成，Frei Otto 隨後以較大的實體模型探索帳篷形狀；但要把形狀變成工廠可裁切、可編網的索長，模型量測精度遠遠不足。sbp 指出此案是這類問題首次使用迭代電腦計算：先假設索網形狀與預拉力，反覆計算節點平衡直到收斂，再由平衡形狀求出每段索的無應力長度。斯圖加特的大地測量學者也參與發展網格平衡計算方法，其後發表的力密度法成為索網與膜結構形狀尋找的基本工具。~The competition concept model was built at 1:1000 from wooden sticks and nylon stocking, and Frei Otto then explored the tent forms with larger physical models; but turning the form into cable lengths that a factory could cut and assemble demanded far more precision than model measurement could give. sbp notes that this project was the first iterative computer application for this class of problem: assume a net shape and prestress, iterate nodal equilibrium until it converges, then derive the unstressed length of every cable segment from the equilibrium shape. Geodesists in Stuttgart helped develop net-equilibrium methods, and the force density method published afterwards became a basic tool for form finding of cable nets and membranes.
units.model: 若 1:100 實體模型的座標量測精度為 ±0.5 mm，換算到實尺度為 ±50 mm；對 750 mm 網目而言約 50/750 ≈ 6.7% 的長度誤差，而索網要求的索段長度精度約在毫米級（約 0.1%），差距約 50 倍。模型比例與精度為教學假設。~If a 1:100 physical model can be measured to ±0.5 mm, that is ±50 mm at full scale; for a 750 mm mesh this is about 50/750 ≈ 6.7% length error, while cable segments need millimetre-level accuracy of about 0.1%, roughly 50 times better. Model scale and accuracy are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以兩種獨立方法（例如不同程式或手算關鍵節點）確認平衡形狀收斂，檢查每個節點的不平衡力小於允許值；把計算形狀與實體模型的量測比較，確認拓撲與整體形態一致；由平衡形狀推得的索長與製造表交叉核對。~Confirm convergence of the equilibrium shape by two independent methods, such as different programs or hand checks of key nodes, checking that residual force at every node is below the allowance; compare the computed shape with physical-model measurements to confirm topology and overall form agree; cross-check cable lengths derived from the equilibrium shape against the fabrication schedule.
units.failure: 若直接以實體模型量測的座標裁切索長，網目長度誤差在實尺度累積，網面無法閉合或局部完全沒有預拉力；計算未收斂就輸出索長，同樣會在現場出現對不上的錨點。~Cutting cable lengths directly from physical-model coordinates accumulates mesh-length errors at full scale, so the surface cannot close or some zones carry no prestress at all; exporting lengths from an unconverged calculation likewise produces anchor points that do not fit on site.
units.misconception: 實體模型做得夠精細，就可以直接用來定出索長。~A sufficiently detailed physical model can be used directly to set cable lengths.
units.practice: 形狀尋找的成果應以平衡形狀座標、各索預拉力與無應力長度三者一起交付，並附收斂準則與檢核紀錄；實體模型適合用來確認形態與構想，不應作為製造尺寸的依據。~Form-finding results should be delivered as equilibrium coordinates, cable prestress and unstressed lengths together, with the convergence criterion and check records attached; physical models are for confirming form and concept, not a basis for fabrication dimensions.

units.anchor: 網面標高與垂度量測~Surface level and sag survey
units.title: 安裝後的幾何量測與索力反算~Post-erection survey and back-calculated cable force
units.mechanism: 索網完成張拉後，最直接的驗證是量測網面節點座標與索段垂度，再與平衡分析預測比較。由於張力與垂度成反比，形狀偏差可以反推張力偏差：垂度比預測大，代表該處張力偏低；垂度比預測小，則可能局部過拉。量測時必須同時記錄溫度與風況，並在日出前等溫度均勻的時段進行；若某網區偏差集中，應檢查錨具位置、索夾滑移或網目長度誤差。~After tensioning, the most direct verification is to survey net node coordinates and segment sags and compare them with the equilibrium analysis. Because tension is inversely proportional to sag, shape deviation can be turned into tension deviation: more sag than predicted means low tension there, less sag may mean local over-tension. Temperature and wind must be recorded and surveys taken at times of uniform temperature such as before sunrise; where deviations cluster in one zone, check anchor positions, clamp slip or mesh-length errors.
units.model: 由 H = wL²/(8f) 可知 ΔH/H ≈ −Δf/f。某索段設計垂度 f = 1.00 m、張力 H = 100 kN，實測垂度 1.10 m，張力約為 100×1.00/1.10 ≈ 91 kN，低約 9%；若實測 0.95 m，張力約 105 kN。垂度與張力為教學假設。~From H = wL²/(8f), ΔH/H ≈ −Δf/f. A segment with design sag f = 1.00 m and tension H = 100 kN that is measured at 1.10 m sag carries about 100×1.00/1.10 ≈ 91 kN, about 9% low; at 0.95 m it carries about 105 kN. Sags and tension are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以全測站或攝影測量量測代表性節點的三維座標，換算到參考溫度後與分析比較；設定允許偏差（例如垂度 ±5%），超出者以頂升或頻率法直接量測索力確認；結果建立為完工基準，日後定期複測比較。~Survey three-dimensional coordinates of representative nodes by total station or photogrammetry, correct to the reference temperature and compare with analysis; set an allowable deviation such as ±5% in sag, and for any exceedance confirm the force directly by lift-off or frequency methods; keep the results as the as-built baseline and resurvey periodically.
units.failure: 在午後日照下量測，鋼索升溫伸長使垂度增加，被誤判為張力不足而去過度張拉，到了冬季索力超過設計；量測點太少，局部鬆弛區未被發現，日後在雪載下才出現積雪窪地。~Surveying in afternoon sun, when warm cables lengthen and sag more, can be misread as low tension and lead to over-stressing, so cable forces exceed design in winter; too few survey points miss a locally slack zone that only reveals itself as a snow pocket under later snow load.
units.misconception: 索網形狀看起來正確，就不必量測張力。~If a cable net looks the right shape, its tension need not be measured.
units.practice: 完工量測計畫應列明量測點位、時段、溫度修正方法與允許偏差，結果與分析模型一起歸檔；量測儀器與控制點須在之後的檢測中重複使用，以確保數據可比較。~The as-built survey plan should state points, time of day, temperature correction and allowable deviation, with results filed together with the analysis model; instruments and control points should be reused in later inspections so data remain comparable.

units.anchor: 壓克力板劣化與更換~Acrylic degradation and replacement
units.title: 覆板老化、混濁與整面更換~Panel ageing, clouding and wholesale replacement
units.mechanism: 原始壓克力板為了防火加入的鐵成分氧化，使板面逐漸混濁變色，後來以不含鐵的塑膠玻璃混合材更換。這是材料配方影響長期性能的典型案例：防火、透光、抗紫外線與熱脹性能要一併考慮，單一性能的改善可能犧牲另一項。更換約 8,300 片覆板是一項大型工程，必須在不破壞索網預拉平衡的前提下分區拆裝，並處理高空作業、臨時防水與場館營運的衝突。~The original acrylic panels contained iron additives for fire protection that oxidised, gradually clouding and discolouring the panels, and they were later replaced with an iron-free plastic–glass material. It is a classic case of formulation governing long-term performance: fire behaviour, light transmission, UV resistance and thermal expansion must be considered together, and improving one property can sacrifice another. Replacing about 8,300 panels is a major undertaking that must proceed zone by zone without disturbing the net's prestress balance, while managing work at height, temporary weatherproofing and venue operations.
units.model: 8,300 片覆板若每日更換 40 片，需約 8,300/40 ≈ 208 個工作天；若受營運與天候限制每日只能 25 片，需約 332 天。每片 9 m² 若自重 4.5 kg/m²（教學假設），單片約 40 kg，拆下一片時節點荷載的變化很小，但整區同時拆除會改變網面荷載分布。施工效率與單位重為教學假設。~Replacing 8,300 panels at 40 per day takes about 8,300/40 ≈ 208 working days; if operations and weather limit work to 25 per day, about 332 days. A 9 m² panel at an assumed 4.5 kg/m² weighs about 40 kg, so removing one changes node loads very little, but stripping a whole zone at once alters the load distribution on the net. Production rates and unit weight are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 新覆板材料先做加速老化、透光率、防火與熱脹試驗，並與原板比較；更換時逐區記錄拆裝順序、臨時防水與網面標高變化；完成後於不同季節檢查接縫與固定件，確認新材料在現場的行為符合試驗。~Test the new panel material for accelerated ageing, light transmission, fire and thermal expansion and compare it with the original; during replacement record removal and installation order, temporary weatherproofing and surface-level changes zone by zone; afterwards inspect joints and fittings in different seasons to confirm field behaviour matches the tests.
units.failure: 為了防火而在材料中加入的成分，若未評估長期耐候，可能讓整個屋面在十多年內失去透光；更換時若一次拆除大面積覆板而未考慮雨雪，網面下方的看台與設備受損，也可能因荷載分布突變引起局部索鬆弛。~An additive introduced for fire protection without long-term weathering assessment can cost the whole roof its transparency within a couple of decades; stripping a large area of panels at once during replacement exposes stands and equipment below to rain and snow and can cause local cable slackening through a sudden change in load distribution.
units.misconception: 只要覆板防火性能更好，就一定是更好的材料。~A cover panel with better fire performance is always the better material.
units.practice: 覆板材料變更要做多性能評估（防火、透光、耐候、熱脹、強度）並保留試驗樣品；更換工程的分區、順序與臨時措施須經結構工程師核可，並在古蹟主管機關的程序下進行。~Changing panel material requires a multi-property assessment of fire, light transmission, weathering, thermal expansion and strength, with test samples retained; the zoning, sequence and temporary measures of replacement work must be approved by the structural engineer and carried out under the heritage authority's procedures.

units.anchor: 古蹟屋蓋重新計算~Recalculation of a listed roof
units.title: 列管古蹟的檢測、重新計算與交接~Inspection, recalculation and handover of a listed roof
units.mechanism: 奧運屋蓋已列為受保護的古蹟建築，sbp 受託重新計算並檢測整個索網屋蓋，記錄其現況；體育場也於 2025 年 10 月起全面封閉整修，預計 2028 年夏季恢復大型活動。五十多年的使用讓鋼索鍍鋅層消耗、鑄鋼節點與錨具承受反覆荷載，原設計所依據的規範與荷載標準也已更新。重新計算的目的是以現行知識檢查既有結構，並找出必須更換或補強的構件，同時盡量保存原貌；所有發現與決策都要寫入可移交的紀錄。~The Olympic roof is a listed building, and sbp was commissioned to recalculate and inspect the entire cable-net roof and record its current condition; the stadium itself fully closed for renovation in October 2025, with major events planned to resume in summer 2028. More than fifty years of service have consumed galvanising on the cables and loaded cast nodes and anchorages repeatedly, while the codes and load standards behind the original design have changed. Recalculation checks the existing structure with current knowledge and identifies components to replace or strengthen while preserving the original as far as possible, and every finding and decision must be written into records that can be handed on.
units.model: 鍍鋅層厚 50 μm，若在大氣腐蝕等級 C3 環境中以每年約 1.5 μm 消耗，約 50/1.5 ≈ 33 年耗盡；屋蓋 1972 年完工至 2025 年已 53 年，未維護的外露部位鍍層可能早已耗盡而開始腐蝕鋼絲。若改用每年 0.7 μm，約 71 年。鍍層厚度與腐蝕速率為教學假設。~A 50 μm zinc coating consumed at about 1.5 μm per year in a C3 atmospheric-corrosivity environment lasts about 50/1.5 ≈ 33 years; the roof was completed in 1972, 53 years before 2025, so unmaintained exposed parts may long since have lost their zinc and begun corroding wires. At 0.7 μm per year it would last about 71 years. Coating thickness and corrosion rates are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以目視、磁性探傷或電磁檢測抽查鋼索斷絲與截面損失，量測代表性索力與網面幾何並與原始資料比較；鑄鋼節點與錨具做非破壞檢測；以現行規範荷載重算，列出利用率超過 1 或接近 1 的構件，提出更換或補強的優先順序。~Spot-check cables for broken wires and section loss by visual, magnetic-flux or electromagnetic inspection, measure representative cable forces and surface geometry against original data, and test cast nodes and anchorages non-destructively; recalculate with current code loads, list components with utilisation above or near 1 and set priorities for replacement or strengthening.
units.failure: 若只因外觀完整就延後檢測，鋼索內層鋼絲的腐蝕或錨具內部的疲勞裂紋可能在多年後突然導致斷索；重新計算若未取得現況索力與幾何，只用原設計值輸入模型，結論可能過於樂觀。~Postponing inspection because the roof looks intact can let corrosion of inner wires or fatigue cracks inside anchorages cause a sudden cable failure years later; a recalculation fed only with original design values, without measured current forces and geometry, may reach over-optimistic conclusions.
units.misconception: 古蹟結構既然已經站了五十年，就證明它一定安全，不需要重新計算。~A heritage structure that has stood for fifty years has proven it is safe and needs no recalculation.
units.practice: 交接與保存文件應包含原始形狀尋找成果、索長與預拉力表、完工量測、歷次覆板更換紀錄、檢測與重新計算報告；任何構件更換都需經結構工程師設計並取得古蹟主管機關核准。~Handover and conservation records should include the original form-finding results, cable-length and prestress schedules, as-built surveys, all panel-replacement records and the inspection and recalculation reports; any component replacement must be designed by the structural engineer and approved by the heritage authority.

example: 設計練習：檢查鞍形網區在雪載下穩定索是否鬆弛。網區懸掛索曲率半徑 R₁ = 40 m、穩定索 R₂ = 60 m，網目 0.75 m。設穩定索預拉 t₂ = 15 kN/m，由 t₁/R₁ = t₂/R₂ 得懸掛索 t₁ = 15×40/60 = 10 kN/m，每根索分別約 11.3 kN 與 7.5 kN。施加 1.0 kPa 雪載並假設兩組各承一半：Δt₁ = +0.5×40 = +20 kN/m，Δt₂ = −0.5×60 = −30 kN/m，穩定索變為 −15 kN/m，即鬆弛，不可接受。要讓穩定索在此荷載下仍保有 5 kN/m，需 t₂ ≥ 30 + 5 = 35 kN/m，對應 t₁ = 35×40/60 ≈ 23.3 kN/m，雪載下懸掛索升至約 43.3 kN/m，每根約 32.5 kN。若把 R₂ 改為 40 m（曲率加大），同一荷載下 Δt₂ 只需 −20 kN/m，t₂ ≥ 25 kN/m 即可。所有數值為教學假設，不代表慕尼黑屋蓋的設計值。~Design exercise: check whether the arching cables of a saddle zone go slack under snow. The hanging cables have curvature radius R₁ = 40 m, the arching cables R₂ = 60 m, with a 0.75 m mesh. With arching prestress t₂ = 15 kN/m, t₁/R₁ = t₂/R₂ gives hanging prestress t₁ = 15×40/60 = 10 kN/m, about 11.3 kN and 7.5 kN per cable respectively. Under 1.0 kPa of snow shared equally, Δt₁ = +0.5×40 = +20 kN/m and Δt₂ = −0.5×60 = −30 kN/m, so the arching family drops to −15 kN/m, which is slack and unacceptable. To keep 5 kN/m in the arching cables under this load needs t₂ ≥ 30 + 5 = 35 kN/m, giving t₁ = 35×40/60 ≈ 23.3 kN/m, and under snow the hanging cables reach about 43.3 kN/m, about 32.5 kN per cable. Reducing R₂ to 40 m (more curvature) lowers Δt₂ to −20 kN/m for the same load, so t₂ ≥ 25 kN/m suffices. All values are teaching assumptions, not the design values of the Munich roof.
history: 1967 年慕尼黑奧運公園建築競圖共收到 104 件作品，Behnisch & Partner 以覆蓋體育場、體育館與游泳館的帳篷屋蓋得獎，Frei Otto 擔任帳篷結構顧問，Leonhardt + Andrä 負責結構，Jörg Schlaich 主導屋蓋完成。原本以模型為主的形狀研究無法提供製造所需精度，團隊因此發展出這類問題首次使用的迭代電腦計算，並以等網目索網、鑄鋼節點與壓克力覆板實現約 74,800 m² 的屋蓋。體育場屋蓋於 1972 年 4 月完成，5 月開幕，同年舉辦奧運；屋蓋現為列管古蹟並持續檢測整修。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~The 1967 architectural competition for Munich's Olympic Park drew 104 entries, and Behnisch & Partner won with a tent roof over the stadium, arena and swimming hall, with Frei Otto as tent-structure consultant, Leonhardt + Andrä as structural engineers and Jörg Schlaich leading the roof's completion. Model-based form studies could not deliver fabrication accuracy, so the team developed what became the first iterative computer application for this class of problem and built about 74,800 m² of roof from uniform-mesh cable nets, cast-steel nodes and acrylic panels. The stadium roof was completed in April 1972 and the stadium opened in May, hosting the Olympics that year; the roof is now a listed monument under ongoing inspection and renovation. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
